messages:
marina: Quick question — I wired up per-model quantization rows into the eval scorecard diff view in Console. After running the int8 experiment on the new 7B variant, the semantic-similarity metric jumps for a few prompts. Did I screw up aggregation or is this legit?

alex: interesting — do you mean the absolute score increased, or just the delta column shows weird values? could you paste a snippet of the generated row? :eyes:

marina: absolute increased for subset A (few-shot prompts) by ~0.08, but subset B drops slightly. Here's the generated row JSON from the report generator: ```{
  "model": "redwood-7b-int8",
  "baseline": "redwood-7b-fp16",
  "metrics": {
    "semantic_similarity_mean": 0.742,
    "semantic_similarity_se": 0.012,
    "exact_match": 0.61
  },
  "diff": {
    "semantic_similarity_mean": 0.081,
    "exact_match": -0.02
  }
}```

jordan: hm, two quick possibilities: 1) the harness uses cosine sim vs embedding normalization mismatch between quantized and fp16 embeddings; 2) the eval runner's sample stratification got shuffled when you added the extra rows. Did you touch the sample selector?

marina: I only added the extra rows and a tiny change to the CSV writer. No re-seed. The runner still uses deterministic seeding AFAICT.

sanjay: CI just posted an alert earlier when the new report job ran — maybe the CI job used a different dataset env var. @marina can you share the exact CI run id? ci-bot, can you paste the job link?

ci-bot: Automated message: nightly-evals/1750704019 finished with status SUCCESS. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/nightly-evals/1750704019 :package:

marina: link received. I pulled the artifacts and see that subset_A sampling file matches local. The embedding normalization step looks suspicious though — in the serialized artifacts the `embed_norm.json` file is missing for the int8 run (only present for fp16).

alex: that would explain cosine diffs — if the harness computed cosine without re-normalizing quantized vectors you can get inflated similarity. The diff view should show a per-metric diagnostic column ("normalization_applied"). Can we add that fast?

jordan: quick patch idea: when writing the scorecard rows, include a diagnostics map with keys: `seed`, `normalization_applied`, `quantization_config`, `embedding_dtype`. Minimal patch: ```python
row['diagnostics'] = dict(
    seed=seed,
    normalization_applied=embeddings is not None and np.linalg.norm(embeddings, axis=1).mean() > 0,
    quantization_config=qcfg.name,
    embedding_dtype=str(embeddings.dtype)
)
```

marina: will try that locally and re-run a subset. If that fixes it we push to nightly and add a Console chart breakpoint to show diagnostics per-model.

sanjay: small CI wiring note — the nightly-evals job currently uploads artifacts to the `evals/` bucket keyed by `model+date`. For diffs we want stable paths like `evals/latest/<model>/` so Console can pull the latest quickly without parsing manifests. I can change the artifact uploader in infra if you want.

marina: yes please. That would make the dashboard sidecar easier. Also, for the Console diff UI — can we show knitted charts where clicking the metric delta expands into a mini-distribution chart and a table of top offending prompts? That would speed up TTR.

alex: +1. UX idea: in the scorecard list show an inline sparkline of both baseline and candidate distributions, and on click open a slim modal with 1) distribution overlay, 2) top 10 prompts ranked by per-prompt delta, 3) the runner diagnostics (seed, dtype, qconfig).

jordan: backend needs an endpoint to return per-prompt diffs for a given run id. We already store per-prompt traces in the artifacts, but not indexed. I can add a small indexer that runs as part of artifact publish — create `index/per_prompt/<model>/<run_id>.ndjson` with lines: `run_id, prompt_id, baseline_metric, candidate_metric, delta`. Then Console can request paginated slices.

marina: perfect. Action items: 1) marina — add diagnostics to scorecard rows + re-run local subset (today). 2) jordan — implement per-prompt indexer in publisher and add a paginated endpoint (this week). 3) sanjay — change artifact paths to `evals/latest/<model>/` and keep run-specific snapshots (this week). 4) alex — sketch Console modal with sparkline + distribution overlay (design spike).

alex: I'll mock up the modal and a quick React component using Recharts. Will push prototype to `eng-ml/designs` and ping here.

marina: I re-ran the subset with diagnostics — found normalization_applied=false for the int8 run (bug). After applying embedding norm before cosine, the semantic-similarity mean aligns with fp16 within noise. Pushing a small fix now. :white_check_mark:

jordan: great. once CI publishes new artifacts with the index we can wire the Console fetch for per-prompt diffs and add the drilldown.

sanjay: infra note: switching artifact layout will require updating retention rules and the napkin script we use to backfill. I'll coordinate with storage team.

marina: thanks everyone. if anyone wants to pair on the modal or runner indexer LMK, otherwise I'll open PRs for diagnostics and the fix.

alex: will review PRs later today. :thumbsup:
